enumerate_attribute_combinations: enumerate all combinations of attribute values given n_attributes and n_values parameters
select_subset_V1_filter_data: select a subset of data where each attribute value is constrained to a chosen set
select_subset_V2_diagonal_sample: sample a subset of data using diagonal sampling to ensure each attribute appears at least once
one_hotify_encode_data: convert a list of attribute configurations into one-hot encoded PyTorch tensors
split_holdout_train_test: split a dataset into train and holdout sets based on zero-value indicators in each sample
